headline: A 1994 executive order sets the order of officials who would temporarily act as Secretary of the Army if needed.
what_it_does: This order lists which Army officials would step in to act as Secretary of the Army if the Secretary dies, resigns, or cannot do the job. It is meant to keep the Army's leadership running without gaps. No summary was provided, so the exact list of officials and any conditions are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Some of them are named in a set order to temporarily take on the Secretary of the Army's duties if the position is empty or the Secretary is unable to serve.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 22, 1994; the effective date is not stated in the information provided.
